column1: # Mirrors the real on-device layout's "advhom" (ota_3) app slot so PlatformIO's
# own overflow check enforces the true 1
# This device is a shared M5Launcher install (see ptable.bin); the actual partition
# table already on the device is NOT flashed from this file. `deploy` writes
# firmware.bin directly to offset 0x5e0000 via esptool and never touches the
# device's partition table. Only the app0 size below matters for the size check.
